title: GetFulfillmentSkuListForMCL
label: LAZADA · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Get Fulfillment SKU List for LAZADA Partner
html:
Request Address

GET/fbl/fulfillment_sku_list/get
RegionBase URL
Vietnamhttps://api.lazada.vn/rest
Singaporehttps://api.lazada.sg/rest
Philippineshttps://api.lazada.com.ph/rest
Malaysiahttps://api.lazada.com.my/rest
Thailandhttps://api.lazada.co.th/rest
Indonesiahttps://api.lazada.co.id/rest

Common Request Parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
app_keyStringYesUnique app ID issued by LAZADA Open Platform console when you apply for an app category
timestampStringYesThe time stamp of the request e.g. 1517820392000 (which translates to 5 February 2018 08:46:32) with less than 7200s difference from UTC time
access_tokenStringYesAPI interface call credentials
sign_methodStringYesThe HMAC hash algorithm you are using to calculate your signature
signStringYesPart of the authentication process that is used for identifying and verifying who is sending a request (click <a target='_blank' href='https://open.lazada.com/apps/doc/doc?nodeId=10450&docId=108068'>here</a> for details)

Request Parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
pageNumberYesPage Index
per_pageStringYesMaximum number of results per page
platform_nameStringYesPlatform name
fulfillment_sku_nameStringNoFulfillment Sku Name
seller_skuStringNoSeller Sku
fulfillment_sku_codeStringNoFulfillment Sku Code
barcodeStringNobarcode
fulfillment_sku_codesStringNoFulfillment Sku Codes

Response Parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
error_messageStringNoError Message
pageNumberNoPage Index
per_pageNumberNoMaximum number of results per page
total_countNumberNoTotal Count
dataObject[]NoFulfillment sku list
  seller_idNumberNoSeller ID
  platform_nameStringNoPlatform name
  owner_idNumberNoFulfillment sku owner ID
  seller_skusStringNoSeller Sku list
  fulfillment_sku_codeStringNoFulfillment Sku Code
  fulfillment_sku_nameStringNoFulfillment Sku Name
  fulfillment_sku_idNumberNoFulfillment Sku ID
  barcodesStringNobarcodes
  serial_num_flagBooleanNoIndicates if the SKU has a serial number.(applies mainly for electronic products)​
  shelf_life_flagBooleanNoIndicates if the SKU has an expiry date​.
  has_stockBooleanNoIndicates if the SKU has stock available in the Warehouse
  min_stock_alertBooleanNoIndicates if the SKU has a low stock alert defined
  platform_sku_statusStringNoPlatform sku status list, active/deactive/delete
  sale_priceStringNofulfillment_sku sale price
  currencyStringNofulfillment_sku currency
  pic_urlsStringNopicurls
successBooleanNosuccess flag
error_codeStringNoError Code
